text:
kari-partnerops: Quick idea — add a 'retention trigger' credit to private offers that vests if the customer renews at >=80% of committed spend in the renewal window (month 10–12). Could help with SI handoffs and give hardware partners better renewal predictability. Thoughts?

sanjay-sales: I like the signal. Two questions: 1) is the credit a cash/invoice credit or a marketing/project credit? 2) does it reduce committed ARR recognition? :thinking_face:

lucy-revops: Prefer marketing/project credit (so it doesn't mess with AR recognition). Also need an expiry and a clear evidence check (usage reports + billing match). Proposed: credit = min(10% of commit, $100k), vests only at renewal >=80% usage.

marta-legal: We should avoid retroactively changing committed revenue. Marketing/project credit that issues at renewal date is cleaner. Add anti-fraud language and require SI attestation for any claimed usage that was facilitated by SI. I'll draft T&Cs.

alex-si: From SI perspective, credits that can be used for onboarding/engineering hours are most useful. If the credit can be issued as a 'service credit' invoice line for partner-delivered work, SI teams will push for it. Also want a simple checklist so SIs can tell customers what's required to qualify.

kari-partnerops: Good notes. Quick calc we can prototype in the playbook: 
```
# retention credit calc (pseudocode)
if renewal_usage_ratio >= 0.8:
  credit = min(commit_value * 0.10, 100000)
else:
  credit = 0
```

kari-partnerops: Implementation details I'm thinking: add a flag on the private-offer object in Console: `retention_credit:{trigger_percent:80, pct:10, cap:100000, type:"project"}`. When renewal window opens, system evaluates usage, flags eligibility, and either issues a credit memo or generates a partner-service credit token.

ops-bot: Created draft doc: /shared/partnerships/retention-credit-playbook.md — please review and comment. :page_facing_up:

lucy-revops: We need two small Console changes: 1) expose `retention_credit_eligibility` on the offer page, 2) add an ops alert 30 days before renewal if a retention credit is attached. Also add exportable evidence bundle (usage CSV + attestations).

marta-legal: cc @finance — need to confirm tax and GAAP treatment for project credits issued at renewal. Also confirm partner accounting impact (will it be treated as contra-revenue or separate marketing expense).

sanjay-sales: I'll loop in finance + hw-partner PM. Also want a short customer-facing message template we can include in the private-offer terms.

alex-si: We'll create a 2-step SI checklist: (1) evidence gather (usage slices + config) (2) onboarding plan that consumes credit. We prefer a credit token that can be invoiced against partner work.

kari-partnerops: Action items: Sanjay — pull finance and hw PM; Lucy — add Console feature requests + alert; Marta — draft legal clause; Alex — SI checklist draft; I'll consolidate into the playbook and aim to get sign-off next Tue. :calendar: 

sanjay-sales: Sounds good. Pinging @hw-partners and @finance in separate threads now. :thumbsup:
